title: Forge Arena protocol v1 draft
description: Task 1.1 catalog contract. Open questions in schema.md section E are deliberately not silently resolved. Additional properties remain allowed on message envelopes until these gaps are decided.

Int32.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/trackable/TrackableObject.java:47 — Java int; individual semantics may further restrict values.

CardRef.$comment: Plan 3.3: visible integer ids; hidden per-seat opaque string ids. Never send Forge hidden ids as a substitute for IdMapper.

PlayerRef.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/GameEntityView.java:16 — PlayerView inherits the integer identity; seat index is a different concept.

Sequence.$comment: Plan 3: monotonic per-seat seq; clientSeq/baseSeq required only on game actions (plan 3.5 E13). Sequence handling finished in task 1.4.

RequestId.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/IIdentifiable.java:4 — Plan 3.5 E13: 32-bit integer ids scoped to one game. Finished in task 1.4.

EntityRef.$comment: Plan 3.5 E8, decided in task 1.2: tagged references distinguish integer namespaces; planeswalkers and battles use kind card. All ids use the per-seat IdMapper.

Counters.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/GameEntityView.java:76 — getCounters() returns Multiset<CounterType>; encode counts under CounterType.toString() keys (enum names, keyword originals or custom names), never localized display labels. Null means empty.

num.$comment: No public collector-number getter on CardView. Use Card.getPaperCard() (forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/card/Card.java:7625), then IPaperCard.getCollectorNumber() (forge-core/src/main/java/forge/item/IPaperCard.java:22); PaperCard.java:79 returns a string or N.A. placeholder. Only when identity is visible.

blocking.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/card/CardView.java:241 — isBlocking(); blockingIds supplies the attacker ids (task 1.2).

attackTarget.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/combat/Combat.java:277 — getDefenderByAttacker(Card); tag the player or card (including planeswalker/battle), null outside combat or for nonattackers.

blockingIds.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/combat/Combat.java:432 — getAttackersBlockedBy(Card) returns every attacker blocked by this card; emit on blocking cards, otherwise omit or use an empty array.

VisibleCard.$comment: Visibility is decided server-side with CardView.canBeShownTo and canFaceDownBeShownTo. Optional fields support partial public card data; see E8 for final required fields.

blocking.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/card/CardView.java:241 — isBlocking(); blockingIds supplies the attacker ids (task 1.2).

attackTarget.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/combat/Combat.java:277 — getDefenderByAttacker(Card); tag the player or card (including planeswalker/battle), null outside combat or for nonattackers.

blockingIds.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/combat/Combat.java:432 — getAttackersBlockedBy(Card) returns every attacker blocked by this card; emit on blocking cards, otherwise omit or use an empty array.

Card.$comment: AnyOf permits identifiable face-down cards as well as identity-free face-down public objects. Schema cannot enforce per-seat visibility; serializer tests must do so.

StackItem.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/spellability/StackItemView.java:146,153,161 — merge getTargetCards, getTargetPlayers and getTargetStackItems as tagged EntityRef objects; null target collections mean empty.

ActiveInput.$comment: Task 1.5: 14 listed Forge Input classes map to 11 dedicated kinds, plus waiting and select. Selection supplies min/max/cards/targets/chosen. Every card reference uses the latest completed IdMapper snapshot; missing refs are omitted until task 1.7. Waiting contains only kind; attackTargets appears only for declareAttackers.

StateSnapshot.$comment: Plan 3.3 full per-seat shape, updated by task 1.2 E8; not the Phase 0 opening-hand placeholder. Null active/priority/phase supports transitions. Game.getMonarch():172 and Game.getHasInitiative():186 provide designations; see protocol/state-fields.md for verified getters.

PromptOption.$comment: Prompt-scoped option slots retain the exact offered Java objects. Plan 3.5 E5 corrected for task 1.6: owner-only prompts reveal offered face-up cards; face-down identity still requires CardVisibility.forSeat permission. Otherwise label is Face-down card with an opaque cardRef and no name/set/num. No Java serialization.

PromptResult.$comment: requestId selects the pending prompt kind. PromptCodec enforces its result type, bounds, offered IDs, capacities and sum; no kind supplied by the client can change that.

skipPhases.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gamemodes/match/YieldStateSnapshot.java:28 — Object-keyed map; JSON encoding pending E6.

YieldSeed.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gamemodes/match/YieldStateSnapshot.java:21 — Field names copied from public record because plan only says snapshot; map encoding remains E6.

YieldUpdate.$comment: Plan 2.6: player inferred from authenticated seat and atOrPastAtClick computed server-side. Authoritative yieldState may need additional fields; see E6.

ZoneRef.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/zone/ZoneView.java:11 — Record fields retained as draft encoding; final event payload mapping is task 1.8/E9.

items.$comment: Plan 3.1: seats, names, deck status and ready flags. No Forge Arena Lobby DTO yet; nesting and status enum need E11.

lobby.$comment: E11: seats is described by the plan; exact payload field layout is unresolved.

deckResult.$comment: E11: parsed commander and count are required concepts but their field names/shape are unspecified; no fabricated DTO.

state.$comment: Plan 3.3 full per-seat shape, updated by task 1.2 E8; not the Phase 0 opening-hand placeholder. Null active/priority/phase supports transitions. Game.getMonarch():172 and Game.getHasInitiative():186 provide designations; see protocol/state-fields.md for verified getters.

result.$comment: Plan 3.1a/task 1.8; event-specific result encoding unresolved E9. Coin bool, numeric die int and planar enum are source-backed below.
forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/event/GameEventRollDie.java:5 — int result plus optional PlanarDice; exact planar encoding and die-size field name E9.

log.$comment: Plan 3.5 E2: type is the log discriminator; entryType carries Forge GameLogEntryType. Finished in task 1.8.

logTail.$comment: Plan 3.1 and 3.5 E2: separate message with the last 200 filtered log entries on reconnect/resync. Finished in task 1.8.

message.$comment: Plan 3.5 E3: flashIncorrectAction emits rejected with generic text; ActionRouter rejections carry their own reason. Title is optional. Finished in task 1.8.

clock.$comment: Plan 3.1: per-seat remainingMs integer and running boolean, but container/id fields and timer source do not exist in this bridge yet (E11).

join.$comment: Plan 3.5 E13: join carries the client protocolVersion; clientSeq/baseSeq are required only on game actions. Finished in task 1.4. Seat-token issuance remains E11 (tasks 1.11, 1.12).

lobbySettings.$comment: Plan values/default 40; update/replace semantics and mixed clock representation require E11.

macroRepeat.$comment: Plan 3.2 and 3.5 E13: count is 1..99 parameterless repeat calls, stopping if a prompt opens. Finished in task 1.4.

nextGame.$comment: Plan 3.5 E4 (decided): rematch -> NextGameDecision.NEW (same decks, fresh game); quit -> QUIT; CONTINUE unused because a match is one game. forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gamemodes/match/NextGameDecision.java:3.

describeAbility.$comment: Plan 3.5 E1: abilityDescription {cardId, text} carries the getActivateDescription result. Finished in task 1.12 area.

GameLogEntryType.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/GameLogEntryType.java:3 — Enum names, not display captions; plan 3.5 E2. Finished in task 1.8.

LogEntry.$comment: Plan 3.1 and 3.5 E2: one filtered historical log entry; seq is the original entry sequence. Finished in task 1.8.

attention.$comment: Plan 3.5 E10 (decided): alertUser; client flashes the taskbar when the action is on this seat and its window is not focused.

abilityDescription.$comment: Plan 3.5 E1: reply to describeAbility; text is IGameController.getActivateDescription return value (forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/interfaces/IGameController.java:52). Finished in task 1.12 area.

CommanderDamage.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/player/PlayerView.java:346 — getCommanderDamage(CardView) reads the damage map by commander.getId(), for the receiving player.

Commander.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/player/PlayerView.java:369 — getCommanderCast(CardView); tax = 2 * casts, matching forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/cost/CostAdjustment.java:58. This is the base command-zone surcharge, before other cost adjustments.

InputCardOffer.$comment: Task 1.7 Input-scoped offers. Face-up hidden-zone cards are revealed only to the choosing seat; face-down identity requires CardVisibility permission (E5). References expire when the Input selection ends.
